text:
Lucia: FYI  small onboarding ingestion disruption overnight affected ~8 tenants; 2 of them are in a renewal window in 4 days. Need a short, personalized note + proactive mitigation to send within 2 hours.

incident-bot: Incident onboard-ingest-delay: detected 2026-09-12T03:22Z, contained 2026-09-12T04:50Z.

Tomas: Sending DM with exact tenant list now. I can pull per-tenant traces and attach verification links.

Lucia: DM list: PaperLeaf (acct_pleaf), HelixCare (acct_helix) are the renewal-risk ones; others are smaller trials. Failures clustered 03:10-03:30 UTC.

Priya: For the two renewal-risk tenants I suggest: choice of a 20% one-time invoice credit OR waiver of the first month onboarding fee, plus 2 hours of dedicated enablement and a private fast-track onboarding session. Also offer a one-click manual re-run.

Wes: SE can do the manual re-runs. Quick command snippet for outreach reference: ```bash
# trigger manual import replay
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.ai/v1/replay \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant":"acct_pleaf"}'
```Will post preview link and doc counts after run.

OpsBot: Root cause (short): transient S3 acknowledgement slowness during nightly maintenance caused queue backpressure and a protective circuit-breaker on q-onboard. Actions: extended S3 client timeout, drained backlog, replayed stuck messages. No data loss; subset required manual replay. Full RCA under legal review.

Lucia: Draft outbound for priority tenants (please edit):

```
Hi <Customer name>,

Were sorry  on Sep 12 UTC a partial ingestion for your account was delayed, which briefly affected document indexing and previews. Our team contained the issue and prioritized a manual replay for affected tenants; verification for your account completed at 04:50 UTC.

What were offering:
- Priority manual replay and verification (we will share a preview link once complete)
- Make-good: choose either a 20% one-time credit on your next invoice OR waiver of the first month onboarding fee
- Enablement: 2 hours of dedicated setup assistance + invitation to a private fast-track onboarding session

If youd like an immediate re-run, reply and well trigger it now. Well also send a very short 3-question feedback form to capture how we did.

Thanks,
Lucia on behalf of Redwood Customer Success
```

Tomas: Add explicit billing language: "credit applied to the first invoice after the incident" and include the console verification steps (Console > Documents > Preview + index counts). Also attach trace links when available.

Priya: Ill send the two personalized emails now and schedule a batch note to the remaining tenants at 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Ill log outreach in the incident tracker and tag renewal owners.

Wes: SE will run replays during the private session and paste preview links back to the outreach thread.

Lucia: Agreed. Send now to PaperLeaf + HelixCare with credit/waiver option and the feedback link: https://feedback.redwood.ai/incident/short. Mark both as "priority outreach" in Gainsight and notify renewal owners.

OpsBot: Replay started for acct_pleaf 2026-09-12T05:01Z, completed 2026-09-12T05:03Z. Index delta +4,512. Preview: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/acct_pleaf/preview

Priya: Sent both high-touch messages and logged in tracker. Batch outbound scheduled. Ill follow up with a 7-day NPS ping and capture responses in the tracker.

Lucia: Closing thread  please update the tracker with any customer replies and capture NPS. Thanks team. (reactions: :white_check_mark:, :heart:)
